predecessors.name: Basutoland
predecessors.text: 'Basutoland gained its independence from the United Kingdom and became the Kingdom of Lesotho on 4 October 1966'

ledger.x: 4 October 1966: Basutoland becomes the independent Kingdom of Lesotho.
22 September 1998: South African troops enter Lesotho.
May 1999: the last South African troops leave.

wars.name: Operation Boleas (SADC intervention in Lesotho)
wars.outcome: The Lesotho government and the SADC force held Maseru; 'the opposition parties accepted an agreement where the LCD government would be restored to power', and the South African troops left in May 1999.

certainty.note: The boundaries 'defined' by the 1869 Aliwal North treaty and unchanged since; the page notes no dispute (a 2010 petition called for 'the practical annexation of the country by South Africa'; the 'Conquered Territory' west of the Caledon is…
